files.CMakeLists.txt:
# Out of source: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(campus_report LANGUAGES CXX)

find_package(fmt 10 REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

add_library(report_core STATIC src/report.cpp)
target_compile_features(report_core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(report_core PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
target_link_libraries(report_core PRIVATE fmt::fmt Threads::Threads)

add_executable(report src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(report PRIVATE report_core)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS report_core EXPORT campus_reportTargets
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    INCLUDES DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(TARGETS report RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(EXPORT campus_reportTargets
    FILE campus_reportTargets.cmake
    NAMESPACE campus::
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/campus_report)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
